from html.parser import HTMLParser
src=open('index.html').read()
class P(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.ids=[]; self.stack=[]; self.errors=[]
        self.void={'meta','link','br','img','input','hr','source','area','base','col','embed','param','track','wbr','path','circle','line','rect','text','title','desc','polyline'}
    def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
        a=dict(attrs)
        if 'id' in a: self.ids.append(a['id'])
        if tag not in self.void: self.stack.append(tag)
    def handle_startendtag(self,tag,attrs):
        a=dict(attrs)
        if 'id' in a: self.ids.append(a['id'])
    def handle_endtag(self,tag):
        if tag in self.void: return
        if not self.stack: self.errors.append(f"stray </{tag}>"); return
        if self.stack[-1]!=tag:
            self.errors.append(f"mismatch: open <{self.stack[-1]}> closed </{tag}>")
        else: self.stack.pop()
p=P(); p.feed(src)
print("unclosed:", p.stack)
print("errors:", p.errors)
dupes=[i for i in set(p.ids) if p.ids.count(i)>1]
print("duplicate ids:", dupes or "none")
import re
controls=set(re.findall(r'aria-controls="([^"]+)"',src))
labelled=set(re.findall(r'aria-labelledby="([^"]+)"',src))
print("aria-controls missing targets:", sorted(controls-set(p.ids)) or "none")
print("aria-labelledby missing targets:", sorted(labelled-set(p.ids)) or "none")
print("href IDs:", [h for h in re.findall(r'href="#([^"]+)"',src) if h not in p.ids] or "all resolve")
print("script/link srcs:", re.findall(r'(?:src|href)="([^"]+\.(?:js|css))"',src))

import re, colorsys

def parse(css):
    vals={}
    for k,v in re.findall(r'(--[a-z0-9-]+):\s*([^;]+);', css):
        vals[k]=v.strip()
    return vals

def resolve(name, vals, depth=0):
    v=vals[name]
    m=re.fullmatch(r'var\((--[a-z0-9-]+)\)', v)
    if m and depth<5: return resolve(m.group(1), vals, depth+1)
    return v

def lum(hexs):
    h=hexs.lstrip('#')
    if len(h)==3: h=''.join(c*2 for c in h)
    r,g,b=[int(h[i:i+2],16)/255 for i in (0,2,4)]
    f=lambda c: c/12.92 if c<=0.03928 else ((c+0.055)/1.055)**2.4
    return 0.2126*f(r)+0.7152*f(g)+0.0722*f(b)

def ratio(a,b):
    la,lb=lum(a),lum(b)
    hi,lo=max(la,lb),min(la,lb)
    return (hi+0.05)/(lo+0.05)

vals=parse(open('styles/tokens.css').read())
for n in ['--paper','--paper-raised','--paper-sunken','--ink','--ink-soft','--ink-faint','--screen','--screen-soft','--screen-faint','--screen-ink','--accent-sci-strong','--accent-graph-strong','--accent-date-strong','--accent-sci-bright','--accent-graph-bright','--accent-date-bright','--on-accent']:
    print(f"{n:24s} {resolve(n,vals)}  L={lum(resolve(n,vals)):.3f}")

print()

import base64, json, os, sys
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

FONTS = {
    "Noto Sans": [("DejaVuSans.ttf", "400"), ("DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", "700")],
    "DejaVu Sans Mono": [("DejaVuSansMono.ttf", "400"), ("DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf", "700")],
}
css = []
for fam, files in FONTS.items():
    for fn, weight in files:
        b = base64.b64encode(open("/tmp/fonts/" + fn, "rb").read()).decode()
        css.append(
            "@font-face{font-family:'%s';src:url(data:font/ttf;base64,%s) format('truetype');"
            "font-weight:%s;font-style:normal;font-display:block}" % (fam, b, weight)
        )
FONT_CSS = "\n".join(css)

URL = "file:///home/user/project/index.html"
results = []
def check(ok, label, extra=""):
    results.append((ok, label, extra))
    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + label + ((" :: " + str(extra)) if extra else ""))

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(args=["--allow-file-access-from-files"])
    ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900})
    page = ctx.new_page()
    logs, errors = [], []
    page.on("console", lambda m: logs.append((m.type, m.text)))
    page.on("pageerror", lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
    page.goto(URL)
    page.add_style_tag(content=FONT_CSS)
    page.wait_for_timeout(250)

    check(not errors, "no page errors on load", errors)
    check(not [l for l in logs if l[0] == "error"], "no console errors on load", logs)

    # ---- initial state
    check(page.evaluate("document.body.dataset.mode") == "scientific", "body[data-mode]=scientific on load")
    check(page.evaluate("location.hash") == "#scientific", "hash set on load", page.evaluate("location.hash"))
    check(page.evaluate("document.getElementById('panel-scientific').hidden") is False, "scientific panel visible")
    check(page.evaluate("document.getElementById('panel-graph').hidden") is True, "graph panel hidden")
    check(page.evaluate("window.Calc && Calc.mode") == "scientific", "Calc.mode exposed")
    check(page.evaluate("typeof Calc.setMode === 'function' && typeof Calc.announce === 'function'"), "Calc API shape")
    check(page.evaluate("typeof Calc.reducedMotion === 'boolean'"), "Calc.reducedMotion boolean")

    # ---- style resolution
    check(page.evaluate("getComputedStyle(document.body).getPropertyValue('--accent').trim()") == "#0f8c7d", "scientific accent token")
    check(page.evaluate("getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#tab-scientific .tab__dot')).backgroundColor") == "rgb(15, 140, 125)", "scientific tab dot colour")
    check(page.evaluate("getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#panel-scientific .key--equals')).backgroundColor") == "rgb(10, 95, 85)", "equals key uses accent-strong")

    # ---- click through modes (click the inner dot to exercise delegation)
    page.click("#tab-graph .tab__dot")
    page.wait_for_timeout(150)
    check(page.evaluate("document.body.dataset.mode") == "graph", "click Graph tab switches mode")
    check(page.evaluate("location.hash") == "#graph", "hash updates to #graph", page.evaluate("location.hash"))
    check(page.evaluate("document.getElementById('panel-scientific').hidden") is True and document.getElementById('panel-graph').hidden is False if False else page.evaluate("document.getElementById('panel-graph').hidden") is False, "graph panel visible")
    check(page.evaluate("document.getElementById('panel-scientific').hidden") is True, "scientific panel hidden again")
    check(page.evaluate("document.getElementById('tab-graph').getAttribute('aria-selected')") == "true", "graph tab aria-selected")
    check(page.evaluate("document.getElementById('tab-graph').tabIndex") == 0 and page.evaluate("document.getElementById('tab-scientific').tabIndex") == -1, "roving tabindex")
    check("Graph mode" in page.evaluate("document.getElementById('mode-announcer').textContent"), "live region announces graph", page.evaluate("document.getElementById('mode-announcer').textContent"))
    check(page.evaluate("getComputedStyle(document.body).getPropertyValue('--accent').trim()") == "#c4550f", "graph accent token")
    check(page.evaluate("getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.mode-status[data-for-mode=graph]')).display") == "flex", "graph mode-status shown")
    check(page.evaluate("getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.spine__word[data-for-mode=graph]')).display") == "block", "graph spine word shown")
    check(page.evaluate("getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.spine__word[data-for-mode=scientific]')).display") == "none", "scientific spine word hidden")

    # ---- keyboard navigation
    page.focus("#tab-graph")
    page.keyboard.press("ArrowRight")
    page.wait_for_timeout(120)
    check(page.evaluate("document.body.dataset.mode") == "date", "ArrowRight -> date")
    check(page.evaluate("document.activeElement.id") == "tab-date", "focus follows arrow key", page.evaluate("document.activeElement.id"))
    page.keyboard.press("ArrowRight")
    page.wait_for_timeout(80)
    check(page.evaluate("document.body.dataset.mode") == "scientific", "ArrowRight wraps to scientific")
    page.keyboard.press("End")
    page.wait_for_timeout(80)
    check(page.evaluate("document.body.dataset.mode") == "date", "End -> date")
    page.keyboard.press("ArrowLeft")
    page.wait_for_timeout(80)
    check(page.evaluate("document.body.dataset.mode") == "graph", "ArrowLeft -> graph")
    page.keyboard.press("Home")
    page.wait_for_timeout(80)
    check(page.evaluate("document.body.dataset.mode") == "scientific", "Home -> scientific")

    # ---- hashchange sync
    page.evaluate("location.hash = '#date'")
    page.wait_for_timeout(150)
    check(page.evaluate("document.body.dataset.mode") == "date", "hashchange drives mode")
    page.evaluate("Calc.setMode('graph')")
    page.wait_for_timeout(120)
    check(page.evaluate("location.hash") == "#graph", "Calc.setMode updates hash")

    # ---- primitives present
    prim = page.evaluate("""() => {
      const q = s => !!document.querySelector(s);
      return {
        panel: q('.panel'), panelHead: q('.panel__head'), readout: q('.readout'),
        key: q('.key'), keyOp: q('.key--op'), keyEquals: q('.key--equals'), keypad: q('.keypad'),
        field: q('.field'), input: q('.input'), select: q('.select'), chip: q('.chip'),
        plot: q('.plot'), srOnly: q('.sr-only'), data: q('.data dl dt') && q('.data dl dd')
      };
    }""")
    check(all(prim.values()), "all required primitives in DOM", prim)

    # aria wiring
    wiring = page.evaluate("""() => {
      const tabs=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]')];
      const panels=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=tabpanel]')];
      const problems=[];
      tabs.forEach(t=>{
        const p=document.getElementById(t.getAttribute('aria-controls'));
        if(!p) problems.push('missing panel for '+t.id);
        else if(p.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')!==t.id) problems.push('panel label mismatch '+p.id);
      });
      if(panels.length!==3) problems.push('panel count '+panels.length);
      return problems;
    }""")
    check(not wiring, "tab/panel aria wiring", wiring)

    # ---- responsive overflow
    for w, h in [(1280, 900), (1024, 800), (820, 900), (720, 1000), (430, 900), (360, 800)]:
        page.set_viewport_size({"width": w, "height": h})
        for mode in ["scientific", "graph", "date"]:
            page.evaluate("Calc.setMode('%s')" % mode)
            page.wait_for_timeout(60)
            m = page.evaluate("""() => {
              const de=document.documentElement;
              const over=[];
              document.querySelectorAll('.panel:not([hidden]) .readout, .panel:not([hidden]) .keypad, .panel:not([hidden]) .plot, .panel:not([hidden]) .field-row, .panel:not([hidden]) .timeline, .tablist, .masthead, .stage').forEach(el=>{
                const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (r.right > de.clientWidth + 1 || r.left < -1) over.push(el.className + ' ' + Math.round(r.right));
              });
              return {scroll: de.scrollWidth, client: de.clientWidth, over};
            }""")
            check(m["scroll"] <= m["client"] + 1 and not m["over"],
                  f"no horizontal overflow @{w}px {mode}", m)

    # ---- touch target + type sizes
    page.set_viewport_size({"width": 1280, "height": 900})
